metadata.title: GatoPouch — The cat-carrying hoodie that keeps your cat close, hands-free
metadata.description: GatoPouch is the polar fleece hoodie with a ventral pouch for carrying your cat close to you, hands-free. Endless cuddles, at home or on walks. From 54,99€, recommended Pack of 2 at 94,98€, free shipping from 69€ (delivery 6 to 12 days).
